column1: # Lonapse 0.6.0: more probe mode events (probe alone, MC answers).

column16: spanish
Empuje completo. Ahí vas.
column17: Full thrust. There you go. | Full thrust. There you go. | Full power. Off you go.

column16: Sí, muy fuerte. Muy valiente.
column17: Yes, very strong. Very brave. | Yes, very strong. Very brave. | Yes. So strong. So brave.

column16: ¡A tope, sonda!
column17: Full throttle, probe! | Full throttle, probe! | Throttle up, probe!

column16: Tranquila. Es solo todo el motor.
column17: Easy. It's just all of the engine. | Easy. It's just all of the engine. | Calm. That's just the whole engine.

column16: Potencia máxima registrada, Okto. Lo apuntamos.
column17: Maximum power logged, Okto. We wrote it down. | Maximum power logged, Okto. We wrote it down. | Max power noted, Okto. It's in the log.

column16: Aguanta, HECS. Sabes hacer esto.
column17: Hold on, HECS. You know how to do this. | Hold on, HECS. You know how to do this. | Hang on, HECS. You've done this before.

column16: Rovemate, esto no es una carrera. Bueno, un poco.
column17: Rovemate, this isn't a race. Well, a little. | Rovemate, this isn't a race. Well, a little. | Not a race, Rovemate. Okay, a small one.

column16: Claro. Todo el empuje del mundo, y ni te despeinas.
column17: Sure. All the thrust in the world, and not a hair out of place. | Sure. All the thrust in the world, and not a hair out of place. | Of course. Full thrust, and still perfectly neat.

column16: Corte de motor. Bien hecho.
column17: Engine cut. Well done. | Engine cut. Well done. | Engine off. Nice.

column16: Sí, ya no hace ruido. Disfruta la calma.
column17: Yes, no more noise. Enjoy the quiet. | Yes, no more noise. Enjoy the quiet. | Quiet now. Enjoy it.

column16: Motor parado. ¿Todo bien?
column17: Engine stopped. All good? | Engine stopped. All good? | Engine off. Okay?

column16: No, no está roto. Solo descansa.
column17: No, it's not broken. It's just resting. | No, it's not broken. It's just resting. | Not broken. Resting.

column16: Se ha parado a propósito, Stayputnik. Tranquilo.
column17: It stopped on purpose, Stayputnik. Easy. | It stopped on purpose, Stayputnik. Easy. | On purpose, Stayputnik. Relax.

column16: Corte perfecto, Okto. Al segundo.
column17: Perfect cutoff, Okto. To the second. | Perfect cutoff, Okto. To the second. | Exact cutoff, Okto. Down to the second.

column16: Lo sé. Lo divertido se acabó. Por ahora.
column17: I know. The fun part is over. For now. | I know. The fun part is over. For now. | I know. Fun is over. For now.

column16: Paracaídas abriéndose. Agárrate.
column17: Chutes opening. Hold on. | Chutes opening. Hold on. | Chutes are opening. Hang on.

column16: Es normal que tire. Todavía no está del todo abierto.
column17: It's normal that it pulls. It's not fully open yet. | It's normal that it pulls. It's not fully open yet. | The pull is normal. Not fully open yet.

column16: Vemos los paracaídas. Primera fase.
column17: We see the chutes. First stage. | We see the chutes. First stage. | Chutes in view. Stage one.

column16: Gracias, Okto. Con que se abran nos vale.
column17: Thanks, Okto. As long as they open, we're happy. | Thanks, Okto. As long as they open, we're happy. | Thanks, Okto. They open. We're happy.

column16: Perdón por las turbulencias, su alteza.
column17: Sorry for the turbulence, your highness. | Sorry for the turbulence, your highness. | Apologies for the bumps, your highness.

column16: Paracaídas abiertos del todo. Qué bonito.
column17: Chutes fully open. How pretty. | Chutes fully open. How pretty. | Full chutes. Lovely.

column16: Descenso suave. Ya puedes relajarte.
column17: Gentle descent. You can relax now. | Gentle descent. You can relax now. | Soft descent. Relax.

column16: Sí, cada vez está más cerca. Así funciona.
column17: Yes, it's getting closer. That's how it works. | Yes, it's getting closer. That's how it works. | Yes, the ground gets closer. That's the idea.

column16: Están abiertos, HECS. Respira. Bueno, ya sabes.
column17: They're open, HECS. Breathe. Well, you know. | They're open, HECS. Breathe. Well, you know. | Open, HECS. Breathe. Sort of.

column16: No te balancees, Rovemate.
column17: Don't swing, Rovemate. | Don't swing, Rovemate. | No swinging, Rovemate.

column16: Igual que en los viejos tiempos, ¿eh?
column17: Just like the old days, huh? | Just like the old days, huh? | Like the good old days, right?

column16: Recibido. Qué cantidad de datos.
column17: Copy. That's a lot of data. | Copy. That's a lot of data. | Copy. So much data.

column16: Llega todo. Los científicos están bailando.
column17: It's all arriving. The scientists are dancing. | It's all arriving. The scientists are dancing. | It's all here. The lab is dancing.

column16: Datos entrando. No entiendo nada, pero me encanta.
column17: Data coming in. I understand nothing, but I love it. | Data coming in. I understand nothing, but I love it. | Data arriving. No idea what it means. Love it.

column16: Te leemos. Los científicos dicen gracias.
column17: We read you. The scientists say thanks. | We read you. The scientists say thanks. | Loud and clear. Thanks from the lab.

column16: Todo ordenado por fecha. Gracias, Okto.
column17: All sorted by date. Thanks, Okto. | All sorted by date. Thanks, Okto. | Sorted by date. Thank you, Okto.

column16: Llegan bien, HECS. No hace falta enviarlo tres veces.
column17: It's arriving fine, HECS. No need to send it three times. | It's arriving fine, HECS. No need to send it three times. | It's fine, HECS. Once is enough.

column16: Más despacio, Rovemate. Se nos llena la libreta.
column17: Slower, Rovemate. Our notebook is filling up. | Slower, Rovemate. Our notebook is filling up. | Slow down, Rovemate. The notebook is full.

column16: Gracias por compartir, su excelencia.
column17: Thanks for sharing, your excellency. | Thanks for sharing, your excellency. | How generous, your excellency.

column16: Recibido, Stayputnik. Aún funciona como el primer día.
column17: Copy, Stayputnik. Still works like the first day. | Copy, Stayputnik. Still works like the first day. | Copy, Stayputnik. Working like day one.

column16: Flotas, sonda. Muy bien.
column17: You're floating, probe. Very good. | You're floating, probe. Very good. | Floating, probe. Good.

column16: Amerizaje. ¿Estás bien ahí abajo?
column17: Splashdown. You okay down there? | Splashdown. You okay down there? | In the water. All okay?

column16: No, no lo puedes traer.
column17: No, you can't bring it. | No, you can't bring it. | No. It stays there.

column16: Amerizaje confirmado, Okto. ¿Te ha entrado agua?
column17: Splashdown confirmed, Okto. Did water get in? | Splashdown confirmed, Okto. Did water get in? | Splashdown, Okto. Any leaks?

column16: ¡Calma, HECS! Los paracaídas te han dejado suave. Flotas.
column17: Calm down, HECS! The chutes set you down gently. You float. | Calm down, HECS! The chutes set you down gently. You float. | Relax, HECS! Soft landing. You're floating.

column16: Lo sé. Agua salada. Qué horror.
column17: I know. Salt water. How awful. | I know. Salt water. How awful. | Salt water. Terrible, I know.

column16: Así se hace, viejo. Flota como un pato.
column17: That's it, old timer. Floats like a duck. | That's it, old timer. Floats like a duck. | There you go, old timer. Like a duck.

column16: Aterrizaje confirmado. De una pieza.
column17: Touchdown confirmed. In one piece. | Touchdown confirmed. In one piece. | Landed. One piece.

column16: ¡Contacto! Aquí aplaude toda la sala.
column17: Contact! The whole room is clapping. | Contact! The whole room is clapping. | Contact! Everyone here is clapping.

column16: Es polvo. Bienvenida a tu nuevo hogar.
column17: That's dust. Welcome to your new home. | That's dust. Welcome to your new home. | Dust. Welcome to {here}, your new home.
column18: |  | Polvo. Bienvenida a {here}, tu nuevo hogar.

column16: Sí, ya puedes ir a explorar. Despacio.
column17: Yes, you can go explore now. Slowly. | Yes, you can go explore now. Slowly. | Go explore. Slowly.

column16: Aterrizaje de libro, Okto. Te lo apuntamos.
column17: Textbook landing, Okto. We'll note it down. | Textbook landing, Okto. We'll note it down. | Perfect landing, Okto. Logged.

column16: Ha llegado su excelencia. ¿Le gusta el sitio?
column17: Your excellency has arrived. Do you like the place? | Your excellency has arrived. Do you like the place? | Welcome to {here}, your excellency. Acceptable?

column16: Acoplamiento completo. Ya tienes compañía.
column17: Docking complete. You've got company. | Docking complete. You've got company. | Docked. Company for you.

column16: Acoplados. Suave como una pluma.
column17: Docked. Soft as a feather. | Docked. Soft as a feather. | Docked. Feather soft.

column16: Sí, ahora sois una sola nave. Portaos bien.
column17: Yes, you're one ship now. Behave. | Yes, you're one ship now. Behave. | One ship now. Be good.

column16: No hace falta saludar tanto, Rovemate.
column17: You don't need to greet it that much, Rovemate. | You don't need to greet it that much, Rovemate. | Not so much greeting, Rovemate.

column16: Sí, es más vieja que tú. Sé amable.
column17: Yes, it's older than you. Be nice. | Yes, it's older than you. Be nice. | It's older than you. Respect.

column16: Eso es un puerto de acoplamiento, Stayputnik. Te lo explico luego.
column17: That's a docking port, Stayputnik. I'll explain later. | That's a docking port, Stayputnik. I'll explain later. | Docking port, Stayputnik. Long story.

column16: Encendido en un minuto. Apunta bien.
column17: Burn in one minute. Point it right. | Burn in one minute. Point it right. | One minute to the burn. Aim well.

column16: Sí, ya casi. No te adelantes.
column17: Yes, nearly there. Don't jump the gun. | Yes, nearly there. Don't jump the gun. | Almost. Don't start early.

column16: Atenta, sonda. Se acerca la maniobra.
column17: Heads up, probe. The maneuver is close. | Heads up, probe. The maneuver is close. | Attention, probe. Maneuver soon.

column16: Gracias, Okto. Nosotros contamos en segundos enteros.
column17: Thanks, Okto. We count in whole seconds. | Thanks, Okto. We count in whole seconds. | Thanks, Okto. Whole seconds are fine.

column16: Todavía no, Rovemate. Espera la marca.
column17: Not yet, Rovemate. Wait for the mark. | Not yet, Rovemate. Wait for the mark. | Wait, Rovemate. Not yet.

column16: Stayputnik, encendido pronto. ¿Estás despierto?
column17: Stayputnik, burn soon. Are you awake? | Stayputnik, burn soon. Are you awake? | Burn soon, Stayputnik. Awake?

column16: Perdón, estaba comiendo. ¿Repites?
column17: Sorry, I was eating. Say again? | Sorry, I was eating. Say again? | Sorry, I was eating {food}. Again?

column16: Se ha cortado. Una vez más, por favor.
column17: It cut out. Once more, please. | It cut out. Once more, please. | You broke up. One more time.

column16: ¿Eso era un sí o un no?
column17: Was that a yes or a no? | Was that a yes or a no? | Yes or no?

column16: Hay mucho ruido. Repite más alto.
column17: There's a lot of noise. Repeat louder. | There's a lot of noise. Repeat louder. | Lots of noise. Louder, please.

column16: Te hemos perdido un momento. ¿Qué decías?
column17: We lost you for a moment. What were you saying? | We lost you for a moment. What were you saying? | Lost you for a second. What was that?

column16: Okto, repite. Más despacio esta vez.
column17: Okto, repeat. Slower this time. | Okto, repeat. Slower this time. | Again, Okto. Slower.

column16: HECS, no te hemos oído. ¿Todo bien?
column17: HECS, we didn't hear you. All good? | HECS, we didn't hear you. All good? | Missed that, HECS. All okay?

column16: Disculpe, su excelencia. ¿Puede repetir?
column17: Excuse me, your excellency. Could you repeat? | Excuse me, your excellency. Could you repeat? | Pardon, your excellency. Once more?
